summary: The team is in the final push to launch the CKGSB-IE report on Chinese companies going global, while simultaneously fixing a critical email lockout and advancing the knowledge website redesign and Asia Star/Intelligent China marketing priorities.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting the whole team; everyone must delete and re-login all email accounts with the new password, update the other computer's Outlook client, check phones, and confirm the backend lock is released with JSB. This week also sees the CKGSB-IE report nearing launch: Julie is updating the press release, Joseph is launching the webpage, Romain is finalizing the one-page flyer, and the team needs to promote it on social media and share the August Business Conditions Index. On the knowledge website redesign, Joseph must share the HTML file and meet with Julie and the speaker for specific feedback, with decisions to remove the video section, integrate videos into topics, and bring indices like BCI to the homepage. Longer-term, the team is prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing, requiring Joseph's draft on target areas, analysis of participant profiles, and a brief on conversion tracking setup. Upcoming deadlines include finalizing the CKGSB-IE flyer after receiving the QR code, confirming Eugene Goh's photo use, and approving additional TIA Conference guests.
